sourceNote: Static offline reference using official JR West and Osaka Metro station/line information. Osaka/Umeda transfer relationships were rechecked against Osaka Metro transfer guidance on 2026-08-10. This is not live timetable, fare, or disruption data.
notice: Offline orientation guide only. Express stopping patterns, through-services, platforms, delays and temporary changes can vary; follow current station signs.

lines.name: Osaka Loop Line
lines.summary: Osaka's JR loop linking Tennoji, Tsuruhashi, Kyobashi, Osaka/Umeda and Nishikujo.

lines.name: JR Kyoto Line
lines.summary: Main JR corridor between Kyoto, Takatsuki, Shin-Osaka and Osaka.
lines.serviceNote: Local, Rapid and Special Rapid trains have different stopping patterns.

lines.name: JR Yumesaki Line
lines.summary: Short JR branch used for Universal Studios Japan.

lines.name: Midosuji Line
lines.summary: Osaka's main north-south subway spine through Shin-Osaka, Umeda, Shinsaibashi, Namba and Tennoji.

lines.name: Tanimachi Line
lines.summary: Long north-south line through Higashi-Umeda, Osaka Castle area and Tennoji.

stations.name: Tanimachi 4-chome
stations.nearby: Osaka Castle / Museum of History area

lines.name: Yotsubashi Line
lines.summary: Alternative north-south subway serving Nishi-Umeda, Hommachi and Namba.

lines.name: Chuo Line
lines.summary: East-west line connecting Yumeshima/Osaka Bay with Hommachi and Osaka Castle area.

stations.name: Tanimachi 4-chome
stations.nearby: Osaka Castle / Museum of History area

lines.serviceNote: The Chuo Line can through-run onto the Kintetsu Keihanna Line beyond Nagata. This guide covers Osaka Metro station numbering C09–C23.

lines.name: Sennichimae Line
lines.summary: Cross-town route useful for Namba, Nippombashi/Kuromon and Tsuruhashi.

lines.name: Sakaisuji Line
lines.summary: Serves Kitahama, Nippombashi and Shinsekai; through-services may continue onto Hankyu lines.
lines.serviceNote: Some trains through-run onto Hankyu lines. Follow the train destination display before boarding.

lines.name: Nagahori Tsurumi-ryokuchi Line
lines.summary: East-west route via Shinsaibashi, Osaka Castle/Business Park and Kyobashi.

lines.name: Imazatosuji Line
lines.summary: Eastern Osaka subway route connecting residential districts with Shigino, Midoribashi and Imazato.

lines.name: New Tram (Nanko Port Town Line)
lines.summary: Automated New Tram serving Osaka's Nanko bay area between Cosmosquare and Suminoekoen.
